mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_provider_config ( provider_id, display_name, protocol, base_url, model, encrypted_api_key, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{providerId}, #{displayName}, #{protocol}, #{baseUrl}, #{model}, #{encryptedApiKey}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, provider_id AS providerId, display_name AS displayName, protocol, base_url AS baseUrl, model, encrypted_api_key AS encryptedApiKey, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM ai_provider_config WHERE provider_id = #{providerId}

SELECT id, provider_id AS providerId, display_name AS displayName, protocol, base_url AS baseUrl, model, encrypted_api_key AS encryptedApiKey, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM ai_provider_config ORDER BY id
